svg.title: HD Enterprise Intelligence Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Anonymized high-definition C4 and swimlane hybrid architecture diagram for the full research, document intelligence, AI orchestration, scoring, storage and output lifecycle.
svg.text: ENTERPRISE INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM
HD C4 + SWIMLANE ARCHITECTURE / ANONYMIZED TECHNICAL SYSTEM MAP / CURRENT PRODUCTION SHAPE
01 USER INTERACTION
browser, extension, research, document, share and export actions
02 FRONTEND APPLICATION
client control plane, state, rendering, document workspace and shared read-only surfaces
03 API GATEWAY + SECURITY
route dispatch, authentication, rate limits, premium gates and safe errors
04 CORE PROCESSING PIPELINES
parallel research and document-intelligence paths with retrieval-first architecture
05 AI ORCHESTRATION + VERIFICATION + SCORING
two active AI routes, consensus checks, citation verification and deterministic quality scoring
06 STORAGE + MEMORY
cloud records, object storage, local cache, user memory, document chunks, exports and telemetry
07 OUTPUT + RESPONSE LIFECYCLE
reports, graph, evidence, shared pages, document answers and exports
